ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL) Two detailed orders dated 28.01.2025 and 06.03.2025 have been passed by us in the present petition taking note of the fact that the correct and complete details with regard to the right of the petitioners in the land in question have not been stated clearly so as to issue any positive mandamus awarding compensation amount to the petitioners.

In compliance of orders dated 28.01.2025 and 11.02.2025,

sentences.text:
C/SCA/984/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/
 
2.

It is stated therein that the petitioners claim themselves to be owners of land bearing Survey Nos.
274 and 276/3 of Village Ramol, Ahmedabad and it is their contention that they had purchased the lands in question along with two other persons, Sanjay Haribhai Thakkar and Rajesh Haribhai Thakkar by way of registered sale deed dated 16.11.2009.

The fact remains that an area admeasuring 914 sq.mtrs., out of total area 2086 sq.mtrs., of Revenue Survey No. 274 and an area admeasuring 1704 sq.mtrs., out of 1828 sq.mtrs., of Revenue Survey No. 276/3 had been acquired for construction of National Highway in the year 2013-14.

The competent authority issued a notice dated 17.01.2017 to the land-holders for production of documents evidencing their entitlement to receive compensation and hand over the possession of the acquired area of their land.

2.1. It is the case of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) in the additional affidavit filed today that the petitioners and other owners of the subject land did not come forward to hand over the vacant possession of the acquired land.

To this contention made in paragraph '4' of the affidavit filed today,
it is vehemently submitted by Mr. Kumar H. Trivedi, learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioners cannot be put at fault, inasmuch as, the National Highway Authority of India has never made any effort to NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/984/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/03/2025 undefined take over possession of the land in question, rather from the communication dated 13.11.2017 sent by the officers of the NHAI, it is evident that the NHAI itself stalled the process of handing over possession on the premise that the subject land was not required for the purposes of acquisition and the process for denotification of the subject land would have to be initiated.
This submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners is admitted by the NHAI by making an averment in paragraph '5' to that effect.

Be that as it may, the fact remains that the possession of the land in question which was acquired in the year 2013-14 remained with the land-holders and neither the possession had been taken by the NHAI nor compensation had been paid to the petitioners.

sentences.text: As per the statement made by the NHAI in the additional affidavit filed today, as per the official government record, the land- holders of the land in question were cultivating the entire area admeasuring 2086 sq.mtr., of Revenue Survey No. 274 and an area admeasuring 1828 sq.mtr., of Revenue Survey No. 276/3.
The revenue records showing the standing crop to prove the factum of cultivation of the lands in question till the year 2021-22 has been appended as Annexure-R1 to the affidavit filed today.

4. Once it is an admitted fact of the matter that the possession of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/984/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/03/2025 undefined the lands in question remained with the land-holders on account of inaction on the part of the NHAI, the fact that the land holders were cultivating the lands in question would be of no relevance.

At the cost of repetition, it is to be noted that even the case of the counsel for the petitioners is that the land in question is in possession of the petitioners who are claiming ownership over the entire areas of Survey Nos. 274 and 276/3.

The submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners about the rights of the petitioners to seek compensation cannot be examined by us in absence of the correct and complete facts stated pertaining to the purchase made by the petitioners in the year 2009 and 2022 as noted in detail in the order dated 06.03.2025.
5.

Insofar as the prayers made by the petitioners in the original writ petition with respect to the denotification of the lands in question, in the detailed order dated 28.01.2025, we have already adjudicated the said issue while keeping it open for the NHAI and the competent authority to do the needful for disbursement of compensation to the land-holders by making due verification about their entitlement.

The prayers made in the writ petition seeking for denotification of the lands in question, which has been acquired by the NHAI in the year 2013-14 on the premise of the communication NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/984/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/03/2025 undefined dated 13.11.2017 sent from the office of the Project Implementation Unit, Ahmedabad, are liable to be rejected, inasmuch as, there is no notification of the Central Government for de-notifying the lands and we have come to a conclusion in the order dated 28.01.2025 that there is no provisions for de-notifying once the acquired land under the National Highways Act, 1956.
6.

However, in order to bring the dispute to its logical end, we dispose of the present petition with the only observations that the National Highways Authority shall deposit the entire compensation amount under the award dated 28.07.2016, if not already deposited with the competent authority.

The compensation under the award with respect to the lands in question, namely Revenue Survey No. 274, admeasuring 914 sq.mtr., and Revenue Survey No. 276/3 admeasuring 1704 sq.mtr., which have been acquired for the purposes of National Highway in the year 2013-14 under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956, shall be disbursed to the land-holders after due verification of their entitlement.

It is kept open for the petitioners to move an application before the competent authority claiming their entitlement to compensation amount, if any, by presenting the papers of their title to the lands in question.

7. Insofar as the observations made in paragraph '17' of the order NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/984/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/03/2025 undefined dated 28.01.2025 about the interest on account of denial of payment of compensation as a result of communication dated 13.11.2017 sent by Amitkumar Pravinbhai Thakkar vs Union Of India on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144465674/
3

8. With the above, no further directions are required to be issued.
The writ petition stands disposed of.
